GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2025-04-03T16:18:59Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Some tools return error messages in Claude Desktop
Description: I used mcp-unity with Claude Desktop. When Claude used the select_gameobject or execute_menu_item tools, they were executed correctly in the Unity editor, but the message returned to Claude Desktop as a result of using the tools was "Unsupported content type: undefined". Claude judges that this tool is not working properly. On the other hand, the notify_message tool returns the message "Message displayed:" correctly. I looked at the source a little, and noticed that in the Unity extension, notify_message returns a json containing "type", while select_gameobject and execute_menu_item do not contain a "type". And I think the error is occurring because the websocket server code is trying to access a non-existent "type". Sorry if I'm mistaken.
